answer: A seat votes with jade, which halves each epoch and is refilled only by burning sable. Each seat's voyage records every ballot it casts. Seats whose voyages agree on 95% of the last 50 ballots form one cluster, and the nth member of a cluster burns n² sable per refill. An honest newcomer burns 1 sable an epoch. An operator running 30 lockstep clones burns 9,455 sable every epoch, indefinitely. Clones that vote apart to avoid clustering cancel out the influence they were bought for.
